description: This file defines an Android Activity 'GridLayout3' that programmatically creates a user interface layout using the android.widget.GridLayout API. It demonstrates how to set up a form with labels, input fields, and buttons arranged in a grid, showcasing the use of grid specifications, alignment, and order preservation properties.

classes.name: GridLayout3
classes.description: An Android Activity that creates a form UI layout using GridLayout to demonstrate grid-based arrangement of views.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method that creates and returns a GridLayout containing the form elements, setting layout parameters and configurations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android lifecycle method that initializes the activity and sets its content view to the layout created by create().
